reports.verdict: Shopify held 32% revenue growth while operating income jumped 66%, and guided to similar growth next quarter.

takeaways.label: Profit outgrowing sales
takeaways.text: Operating income rose 66% to $568 million on 32% revenue growth. Free cash flow margin reached 22%, up from 18% a year earlier.

takeaways.label: Steady growth outlook
takeaways.text: Fourth-quarter revenue is guided to grow at a low-thirties rate, matching this quarter. Free cash flow margin is guided to match last year's fourth quarter.

takeaways.label: Gross profit lags revenue
takeaways.text: Gross profit grew 28% versus 32% for revenue, and fourth-quarter gross profit is guided to high-twenties growth, so more sales come from lower-margin payments.

takeaways.label: Buybacks begin
takeaways.text: Shopify spent $562 million repurchasing stock this quarter, versus nothing a year earlier, while losses on payments and loans fell to $120 million from $148 million.

reports.verdict: Teva's three growth drugs surged 33% and full-year guidance rose again, but generic declines held total revenue down 2% for the quarter.

takeaways.label: Growth brands accelerating
takeaways.text: Austedo, Ajovy and Uzedy together reached about $1.1 billion, up 33%. Ajovy grew 61% and Uzedy 96%, while Austedo rose 21% to $751 million.

takeaways.label: Guidance raised again
takeaways.text: 2026 revenue outlook is now $16.7–17.0 billion, up from $16.5–16.85 billion. Ajovy guidance jumped to $930–960 million from $850–870 million; Austedo to $2.55–2.65 billion.

takeaways.label: Margins improving
takeaways.text: Adjusted gross margin rose to 58.7% from 55.3%. Adjusted EPS was $0.86 versus $0.78 a year earlier.

takeaways.label: Generics still a drag
takeaways.text: Revenue fell 2% to $4.4 billion, mainly because sales of the generic cancer drug lenalidomide dropped in the U.S.

reports.verdict: Pfizer raised its 2026 outlook as new and acquired drugs offset sinking COVID sales, though quarterly revenue and profit were flat.

takeaways.label: Outlook raised
takeaways.text: Full-year revenue guidance rose $1.5B at the midpoint to $62-64B. Adjusted EPS guidance rose to $2.95-$3.05 from $2.80-$3.00, absorbing a roughly $0.10 one-time charge.

takeaways.label: Growth drivers vs. COVID drag
takeaways.text: Revenue was flat at $16.6B. Excluding COVID products it grew 7%, and newer and acquired drugs grew 32%, led by Padcev up 55%.

takeaways.label: Eliquis boost is price-driven
takeaways.text: Eliquis rose 25% (+$513M), mainly from lower rebates and channel mix in the U.S. rather than demand alone, so the gain may not repeat.

takeaways.label: Pressure points
takeaways.text: Paxlovid fell 63% and Comirnaty 29%. Prevnar fell 10% on lower U.S. vaccination rates and lost adult market share. R&D spending rose 18%.

reports.verdict: Refining profits hit another record on war-inflated margins, and management expects them to stay high through mid-2027 while it sells two refineries for cash.

takeaways.label: Record margins again
takeaways.text: Profit per barrel refined jumped to $45.70 from $17.60 a year ago. Adjusted earnings were $26.93 a share, above the roughly $24.5 analysts expected.

takeaways.label: Margins seen lasting
takeaways.text: Management expects elevated margins through at least mid-2027, citing about 10 million barrels a day of global refining capacity offline, and says it has seen no demand destruction.

takeaways.label: Selling two refineries
takeaways.text: Marathon is selling its St. Paul Park and Mandan refineries to CVR Energy for $4.2 billion, with $3.45 billion going to Marathon. Proceeds go mainly to the Gulf Coast.

takeaways.label: Heavy cash return
takeaways.text: Marathon returned $3.3 billion in the quarter, raised its dividend 10% and added a $5 billion buyback authorization. It holds $13.6 billion in cash.

reports.verdict: Record quarter, but Apple guided December gross margin down to 45%–46% as memory costs climb, and gave no outlook past that.

takeaways.label: Margins squeezed by memory
takeaways.text: December-quarter gross margin is guided to 45%–46%, below the 47.9% just reported (about 1 point of which came from tariff refunds) and below the 46.3% analysts expected. Memory prices are still rising.

takeaways.label: Growth slowing
takeaways.text: December-quarter revenue is guided up 7%–10%, down from 12% this quarter. Services is guided up 8%–9%. Mac and iPad supply stays limited by memory availability.

takeaways.label: AI spending climbing
takeaways.text: Operating expenses are expected to rise 11%–13% next quarter on AI investment. R&D already jumped about 32% to $11.7 billion in the September quarter.

takeaways.label: Strong quarter and year
takeaways.text: Revenue was $114.5 billion (up 12%) and EPS $2.10, both September-quarter records. iPhone grew 17% to $57.6 billion and Greater China grew 21%. Full-year revenue hit $479 billion.

reports.verdict: Palantir's growth is still accelerating: revenue nearly doubled, US business customers overtook government for the first time, and full-year guidance rose again.

takeaways.label: Growth keeps accelerating
takeaways.text: Revenue rose 96% to $2.313B, topping $2B for the first time. The full-year forecast rose to about $8.53B from about $8.15B three months ago.

takeaways.label: Commercial overtakes government
takeaways.text: US commercial revenue grew 148% to $984M, passing US government revenue of $953M for the first time. Government revenue also grew 96%.

takeaways.label: Profits and cash surge
takeaways.text: Adjusted operating margin was 62% and free cash flow was $1.2B, or 53% of revenue. Net income was $1.13B, and cash and Treasuries total $10.4B.

takeaways.label: New deal value lags revenue
takeaways.text: Total value of newly signed contracts rose only 6% to $2.92B, far slower than revenue. US commercial contract value rose 11%, a possible sign growth will cool.

reports.verdict: Refining windfall and a $20 billion 2027 buyback plan lifted shares.

reasons.label: Big refining rebound
reasons.text: Fuel-making profit more than doubled to $9.1 billion from $4.1 billion last quarter.

reasons.label: Huge 2027 buyback
reasons.text: Plans $20 billion of share repurchases in 2027, after $5.1 billion bought this quarter.

reasons.label: Strong cash, less debt
reasons.text: Free cash flow was $19.1 billion, and net debt fell by nearly $11 billion this year.

reports.verdict: Refining-driven profit beat expectations, lifting shares modestly despite lower production and oil prices.

reasons.label: Refining profits surged
reasons.text: Fuel margins pushed refining earnings to $4.9 billion from $1.1 billion a year earlier.

reasons.label: Beat on estimates
reasons.text: Adjusted EPS of $5.28 topped the roughly $4.89 analyst average.

reasons.label: Cash and debt gains
reasons.text: Free cash flow near $14.2 billion; net debt fell to $20.7 billion from $34.5 billion.

reports.verdict: Revenue beat estimates and AbbVie raised its outlook again, lifting the stock modestly.

reasons.label: Outlook raised again
reasons.text: 2026 profit guidance lifted to $13.95–$13.99 from $13.76–$13.96, and the dividend rises 5.2%.

reasons.label: Revenue beat estimates
reasons.text: Sales of $17.4B (up 10.3%) topped the roughly $17.3B analysts expected.

reasons.label: Immunology drugs surging
reasons.text: Skyrizi grew 22.7% and Rinvoq 23.9%, more than offsetting Humira's 31% decline.
